No new live production failure, calibrated renderer or unavailable-range scenario is established by compilation or existing unit selection.
Actual nonempty outputs and exact tested revision must be inspected after hosted execution; source names alone do not prove execution.

Select strategic_scene:: in addition to all ten previous planned cells because the connected preparation/error/anchor family now changes these paths. Require nonempty hosted output; source inventory is not execution.
